description: A sturdy horn carved from bone with a brass mouthpiece.  Produces a deep, resonant tone that drives tamed creatures into a frenzy; their damage and speed spike for about two minutes, followed by a brief crash as the rush wears off.  Use sparingly.

A sealed glass vial of concentrated synthetic insect pheromones.  Crack it open briefly and it puts out a burst of chemical signals that drive tamed arthropods into a frenzy; their damage and speed spike for about two minutes, followed by a brief crash.  Close it fast to save the contents.

A handheld device that puts out a short electromagnetic pulse on frequencies robots and automated systems respond to.  Tamed machines read the signal as a priority override and enter a high-performance combat mode; their damage and speed spike for about two minutes, followed by a brief cooldown cycle.

A disturbing crystalline device that vibrates at frequencies partially outside normal space-time.  When activated, it puts out a resonance that drives tamed nether creatures into a frenzy; their damage and speed spike for about two minutes, followed by a brief period of disorientation.  Extended use may cause headaches and nosebleeds.

A carefully-made multi-frequency whistle that produces sounds spanning the full audible spectrum and beyond.  Combines ultrasonic tones, subsonic vibrations, pheromone dispersal, and a faint electromagnetic pulse.  When blown, ALL tamed creatures in the area enter a frenzied state; their damage and speed spike for about two minutes, followed by a brief crash.
